t: This is Beechwood House, a large Grade II listed detached house on Hampstead Lane in Highgate, set in eleven acres of grounds. It was built in 1840 for Nathaniel Basevi, a barrister, by his brother George Basevi, the architect and developer. George Basevi also designed Belgrave Square and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. Over the years the house has belonged to several prominent people, including the politicians Lewis McIver and Oswald Lewis, and King Khalid of Saudi Arabia. Today it is owned by trusts linked to the businessman Alisher Usmanov.
